entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
The latest 1News Verian poll has Labour down 5 points on 32 percent, and National down 1 point to 29 percent | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

The results point to the major parties' lowest level of support since the first MMP election in 1996 and its lowest under leader Christopher Luxon in the Verian poll.
 
Speaking to media on Wednesday, Christopher Luxon was not concerned by the poll result, saying there were lots of polls. He said National had a lot of work to do to ensure New Zealanders understood the party's long-term plan.
 
Despite the risk that some National MPs could lose their places in Parliament, Luxon said the party was "very focused".
 
Responding to Opportunity's result, and questions on whether National would work with the party, Luxon said National was already clear about the parties it would work with. 

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/618673/labour-national-downplay-tepid-results-in-1news-verian-poll
